_comment: Loaded per pane via `claude --settings` (see session.ts). Additive — the user's own settings still apply. SessionStart fires on startup, resume, /clear and compact, which is every moment a pane's session id can change, so this marker is the only reliable answer to 'which transcript is this pane on'. Same shape as the wake markers in %TEMP%\loom-wait. The statusLine is a tee (`loom.exe --statusline`, helper.rs; path templated in by pty_spawn): Claude Code pushes fresh model/effort into it on every state change, the tee drops that in %TEMP%\loom-status and then chains to the user's own statusline so their bar still draws.

hooks.command: if ($env:LOOM_PANE) { try { $h = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($h.transcript_path) { $d = "$env:TEMP\loom-tx"; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null; Set-Content -LiteralPath "$d\$env:LOOM_PANE" -Value $h.transcript_path -Encoding ascii -NoNewline } } catch {} }
